responsibilities: Developed responsive web applications using modern front-end technologies.
Collaborated with designers and backend developers to improve UI/UX.
Implemented SEO best practices and optimized website performance.
Assisted in building websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Worked closely with senior developers to enhance functionality.
Tested and debugged web pages to ensure cross-browser compatibility.

personal_projects.name: Responsive Portfolio Website
personal_projects.description: Developed a personal portfolio website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to showcase my work and skills. Implemented responsive design and optimized for mobile.

personal_projects.name: Weather App
personal_projects.description: Created a weather forecasting application using JavaScript and the OpenWeather API. Users can search for any city to get current weather information.

personal_projects.name: Task Manager
personal_projects.description: Built a task manager app with React that allows users to add, edit, and delete tasks. Used local storage to save data persistently.

personal_projects.name: E-commerce Web Application
personal_projects.description: Developed a full-stack e-commerce app with React, Node.js, and MongoDB, featuring product listings, shopping cart, and user authentication.

personal_projects.name: Personal Blog
personal_projects.description: Built a personal blog platform with user authentication and content management system, where users can create and manage posts.
